# Turso engine 0.8.3 (@tursodatabase/database, same engine core as @tursodatabase/sync-react-native 0.8.3)
# on macOS with TMPDIR pointed at a directory the process cannot write, like /data/local/tmp for an Android app.
# The queries are the replica queries from features/cloudSync/services/syncEngine.ts, on a replica holding 300 rows.

$ TMPDIR=<unwritable> node appqueries.mjs   # temp_store=default
FAIL  summarizeCloud: step failed: I/O error (tempdir): permission denied
ok    sync_info (0 rows)
ok    fetchByIds (3 rows)
ok    all (300 rows)

$ TMPDIR=<unwritable> node appqueries.mjs   # temp_store=memory
ok    summarizeCloud (300 rows)
ok    sync_info (0 rows)
ok    fetchByIds (3 rows)
ok    all (300 rows)

# Android 16 emulator (Money2Time_Pixel_10), Money2Time 1.7.0 release build, checked as root with the app's own uid:
- /proc/<pid>/environ of com.nelsongan.money2time holds no TMPDIR (Android adds it later, from the cache dir, only when that dir is available).
- su u0_a215 mkdir /data/local/tmp/m2t_probe -> mkdir: '/data/local/tmp/m2t_probe': Permission denied
- /system/framework/framework.jar contains the TMPDIR setup and its fallback log line: Unable to initialize $TMPDIR
